_comment: Phase 8 named systems under study. Each system is a STUDY TOPIC ONLY: members are listed ONLY where our own atlas structure records support gross-anatomical co-location; every other classically described member is an explicit member_gap (NOT_REPRESENTED). Overall certainty is LOW for all systems with stated reasons. RDoC is cited as framework identity only — no matrix/domain/construct content is asserted.
framework_identity_note: The NIMH Research Domain Criteria (RDoC) framework (https://www.nimh.nih.gov/research/research-funded-by-nimh/rdoc) is cited below as framework identity only: it names the research-framework context in which systems of this kind are studied. No RDoC domain, construct, subconstruct, unit-of-analysis, or matrix content is asserted for any system — none was verified against the matrix.
